title: Vanishing Cech cohomology on all coverings implies vanishing derived cohomology
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, let $\mathcal F$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $H^q(U,\mathcal F)$ be the right derived functors of sections over an object $U$ in the abelian category of sheaves of abelian groups on $\mathcal C$. If for every covering $\mathcal U$ of every object $U$ the Cech cohomology $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ vanishes for all $p>0$, then $H^q(U,\mathcal F)=0$ for every object $U$ and every $q>0$.
